question: {Simplify: } 3( ((4)/(3))x² - 25x + 12 ) - 4( x² + 7x - 18 ).
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 3( (4/3)x² - 25x + 12 ) - 4( x² + 7x - 18 )

**Formula Used:**

Distributive Property: a(b + c) = ab + ac

Simplify and combine like terms.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3( (4/3)x² - 25x + 12 ) - 4( x² + 7x - 18 )

⇒ (3 × (4/3)x²) + (3 × -25x) + (3 × 12) - (4 × x²) - (4 × 7x) - (4 × -18)

⇒ 4x² - 75x + 36 - 4x² - 28x + 72

⇒ (4x² - 4x²) + (-75x - 28x) + (36 + 72)

⇒ 0x² - 103x + 108

⇒ -103x + 108

**∴ The correct answer is -103x + 108.**
